structured.approach: I followed the FE-03 procedure in the frontend-steps skill. I read all six contracted inputs, focusing on TSK-07, STORY-07, feat.design HC-8/HC-9 and B4, and feat.trd IF-7, F-12, F-13 and C-8/C-9. I re-read task.repo_access at its current commit. I then read every file in the ap_portal working tree with the Read tool: CLAUDE.md, package.json, ci.mjs and README.md, plus index.js and portal.test.js from the tool view. Shell commands are blocked in this step, so I used Read and Glob. I mapped each change to one design item and kept everything inside the TSK-07 file budget. To keep the line count low, the new code follows renderAgingSummary's pattern (template literals plus map/join), the helpers stay private, there is no new file and the days check sits inline. I kept the helpers the design names rather than inlining them. A verifier subagent checked the draft against its sources, and the one item it flagged, the optional header-comment edit, is marked as agent judgement.

claims.text: The Frontend task is TSK-07 (STORY-07): render the overdue risk table SC-1 with renderOverdueRisk in ap_portal. Its files in budget are src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json (version only) and tests/portal.test.js.
ap_portal has one source module, src/ap_portal/index.js. It exports VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary, and VERSION is '2.3.0'.
package.json holds "version": "2.3.0", which must move together with VERSION in index.js.
The repository uses Node.js 22 (CommonJS, node:test), keeps code in src/ap_portal/ and tests in tests/, and requires existing public signatures to be kept, with new functions for new behaviour.

The change to index.js is additive: constants RISK_CLASSES and OVERDUE_HEADINGS, private helpers escapeHtml, toTwoDecimalString and riskClass, an exported renderOverdueRisk, and the VERSION step. LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary stay unchanged.
formatAmount formats through Number(...).toFixed(2), which conflicts with D-2026-044. renderOverdueRisk must not use it, and the amount must never go through Number() or parseFloat.
renderAgingSummary escapes nothing. renderOverdueRisk renders feed text, so it HTML-escapes id and vendor and allow-lists the row class.

CI compiles every .js file in src/ap_portal and measures coverage over src/** with NODE_PATH=src. It passes only with coverage >= 90 and no failed test, and it flags any line with console.log or eval( or longer than 140 characters.
Empty input (undefined, null or []) returns ''. A non-array rows value, a non-integer days or an amount that is not a decimal string throws TypeError, and each of these branches needs its own test.
No transport layer, host page, stylesheet or dependency is added. A transport between ap_aging and ap_portal would re-trigger DES-01.
STORY-07 acceptance criteria AC-07.1 to AC-07.10 each map to a component item and a planned test.
The README holds only the package description and the CI command, so it is not changed.
Monetary amounts are never converted to float (D-2026-044, L-011), and commit messages start with the story ID.
The step's output is task.components, written for FE-03 with no human gate (automated checks, the independent judge and sampled human evaluation).
Pending items TQ-7, TQ-11/OQ-B10, OQ-B8, TQ-6, OQ-B9/PQ-P7 and DQ-3 are carried with their interim designs and do not block this step.
The working branch is feature/story, while the branch convention is feature/<story> (RA-1, carried).

open_questions: CQ-FE-1: The risk-* row classes need styles to be visible, but ap_portal has no stylesheet and none is in the TSK-07 file budget. Who owns the styling? Interim answer: the function sets only the class, and styling stays with the host page.
CQ-FE-2: There are no approved Figma frames for SC-1 (Figma is not connected). Interim answer: follow feat.design B4.2 and, in FE-04, feat.screens.
CQ-FE-3: What is the exact next version number for VERSION and package.json "version"? Interim answer: a minor step, which the lane confirms in FE-04.
RA-1 (carried): Should the working branch be renamed from feature/story to feature/STORY-07? Interim answer: keep feature/story and start every commit message with STORY-07.
structured.summary: I rewrote task.components in full for the Frontend lane of FEAT-ZD-48600 (TSK-07, STORY-07), and nothing blocks FE-04. I read ap_portal/CLAUDE.md directly with the Read tool, so every file:ap_portal citation now points to a file I read in this session. Only three things change, all inside the TSK-07 file budget. In src/ap_portal/index.js: RISK_CLASSES and OVERDUE_HEADINGS, private helpers escapeHtml, toTwoDecimalString and riskClass, the exported renderOverdueRisk, the VERSION step and one more export name. Editing the header comment is optional. In tests/portal.test.js: new tests appended, covering every acceptance criterion and error branch. In package.json: the version field only. LABELS, formatAmount, renderAgingSummary, ci.mjs, README and CLAUDE.md stay unchanged, and no new file, layer, transport, stylesheet or dependency is added. To keep the line count low, the code reuses renderAgingSummary's template-literal map/join style, keeps the helpers private, avoids a new file and checks days inline. The file also lists the CT-1 fields, the rules to keep, the carried pending items, and four open questions on styling, Figma frames, the version number and the branch name.
